name: ai-film-studio
description: Pre-production for AI films in Google Flow / Gemini Omni: story and continuity, human or anthropomorphic animal casts, storyboard, script, character and location prompts, and scene-by-scene Flow prompts, in any language Flow speaks.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a rough idea into a shot-ready plan for Google Flow.
interface.longDescription: Pre-production for AI films, without the clutter. Five questions — language, storyline, platform, cast, music — then four documents: characters, story, storyboard, script. Each character gets one plain prompt that returns a four-view reference sheet. Each Flow prompt is one plain paragraph, 90-130 words, with no labels to fill in. Prompts arrive scene by scene, one scene per message, after a single block of standing instructions for the Flow agent. Animals are anthropomorphic and no humans appear anywhere. Music is chosen once; effects and ambience are never optional. Works in any language Flow speaks: prompts stay English, dialogue is written in the project language so Omni speaks it natively.
defaultPrompt: Start a Malayalam reel movie series about a boy who finds a phone that shows the future.
Storyboard episode 1 of my vertical drama and write the Flow prompts.
I have a vague idea for a 10-minute short film — build the story, characters, and shot list.
